title: Unit 18 Consolidation: Saying How It Was Said
goal: Review reporting verbs and their mood, and reporting from a distance, and read a short text about Alegría and El mundo es ancho y ajeno.
grammar: Review of reporting verbs and reporting from a distance

items: I can choose the reporting verb and the mood for statements, denials, warnings and reproaches.
I can report a claim from a distance, without saying it is true.
I can read a short text about Ciro Alegría and his novel El mundo es ancho y ajeno.
